verdict.rationale: Working Copy has its own Identity with an attached private key, imported or generated in-app. That key can be kept on the Secure Enclave behind Face ID or Touch ID, and the same public key can be auto-registered with both GitHub and BitBucket. This implies one stored SSH credential reused across hosts. The evidence covers only SSH keys and never describes a general credential vault or how stored credentials are referenced per host. missing for 10: documented vault for https passwords/tokens, explicit per-host credential reference/reuse docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
